[NCBK.7.3] **The persistence callbacks are OPTIONAL, independently.** A NULL
`set_cb` / `delete_cb` is not an error — the corresponding write still mutates
the engine's cache; it is simply not persisted (a volatile cache, [LSTO.4.3.2]).
An integrator that wants durability wires both; one wired and one NULL persists
only that op. Registering neither (the default) is a fully working volatile
cache. `cached()` reads work regardless — they never touch a callback.
